choices.decline_signed_body: Maximum reliability, minimum deniability. Everyone knows you declined, and that your GossipID matches the claimed leave.
choices.leave_signed_body: Maximum reliability, minimum deniability. Everyone knows you left, and that your GossipID matches the claimed leave.
choices.ask_kick: Ask to be kicked (visible only to chat owner)
choices.ask_kick_body: Good balance of reliability and deniability. You may get accidentally re-added later on rare occasions. The member list stays on this device as a local trace until the owner removes you, for up to 2 weeks. Messages are deleted at once.
choices.ignore: Ignore and Delete (visible to no one)
choices.ignore_body: Minimum reliability, maximum deniability. You may get invited again regularly on active chats with a lot of member list changes, especially where other members share other chats with you.
choices.handover_leave: Hand over and leave (visible to everyone)
choices.handover_leave_body: Pick the next owner. They become the owner at once and you are removed. Everyone knows you left and who you named. This cannot be undone.
choices.dissolve_keep_body: Ends the group for everyone. Nothing is deleted on anyone's device. This cannot be undone.
choices.dissolve_delete_body: Ends the group and attempts to delete it on every member's device on a best effort basis for peers that are reachable, copies may still exist (offline peer, backups, unofficial clients, compromised devices).
choices.owner_ignore_body: Deletes the group from this device and tells no one. The group is left without an owner: nobody can add or remove members, and members who leave are never removed. You remain listed as the owner and may get the group back if a member sends it to you again.
choices.delete_group_body: Deletes the group from this device.

message_menu.delete_confirm_body: Members who receive the deletion remove the message. Copies already received may remain on devices that never receive it.

message_menu.edit_locally_body: Changes the stored message on this device only. Nothing is sent, no indicator is added, and this device stops sharing any version of it. Packets already sent may still carry the earlier content.
